name: embedded-ai-harness-testbench
description: Drive the Embedded AI Harness testbench (Raspberry Pi ESP32 test bench) from Claude: SDR, signal generator, flashing, OTA, serial, WiFi/provisioning, MQTT, BLE, GPIO, GDB debug.
long_description: Exposes the testbench HTTP API as MCP tools so Claude can operate the bench conversationally. Zero Python dependencies (standard library only) — you only need Python 3 on this machine and network reach to the testbench. Set the testbench URL when you install.

testbench_url.title: Testbench URL
testbench_url.description: Base URL of your testbench as an IP, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8080. Use the address, not a .local name — mDNS does not resolve from containers. The portal's home page and GET /api/info both report it.
